body: ["Too many API requests have been detected from your client.  To download GBIF occurrence data in bulk, request a download through the website <https://www.gbif.org/occurrence/search>, the API <https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/data-use/api-downloads>, or use the free public cloud datasets <https://www.gbif.org/occurrence-snapshot>.","We can also provide data about downloads, datasets, citations and so on in CSV or some other format, please contact helpdesk@gbif.org."]
